locations.note: Jimmy Patterson's first mission: find a downed plane and a captured G3 officer behind the lines in Normandy.
Patterson storms the fortress and its mustard-gas works in the Siegfried Forest.
Sabotage the Rjukan Hydro Plant: through the penstocks and generator halls to the heavy-water cellar.
Capture the Secret German Treasure: the looted art and gold hidden in the caverns of the Merkers mine.
